task: Tell me what OS and Python version is running on this machine.

contract.task: Tell me what OS and Python version is running on this machine.

clauses.instruction: Derive the task-scoped argument tokens for the registered system-info helper to report the operating system and Python version requested by the user.
Run the registered system-info helper as necessary to obtain the operating system and Python version requested by the user.
Acquire the return text from the authorized registered system-info helper run containing the machine system information needed for the requested operating system and Python version.
Extract and format the operating system and Python version from the acquired system information as the task-requested answer to the user.
